limits: Tracker likely_flaky heuristic uses pass-fail-pass across different revisions/configurations; its nine samples are not verified same-source recoveries. A separate selected PR retry is verified same-tree.
Selected failed target records prove noncached test-result events and physical execution IDs, but complete physical denominator was not collected.
Target-history rows include cached results and cannot be used as physical exposure.
Current merged-PR rollup may hide earlier reruns; no explicit bypass/audit event was established.
Raw logs and traces retained only in local scratch.
